subject: Request to revive expired trial credits — Luminary AI
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@luminary.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-25T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Trial ended early — request to restore credits

Hi Dylan / Monica,

Quick context: we onboarded a small ML team on a 30-day trial two months ago; we were running a short burst of evaluation experiments and hit quota early when a pipeline rerun consumed a lot more tokens than expected. The trial has now lapsed and we can't finish a few critical evaluations before our product review next week.

Can Redwood make a one-time reactivation or temporary credit top-up so we can finish the evals? We used the hosted API; attached is a usage snapshot and the minimal list of prompts we need to re-run. If helpful we can produce a short mutual action plan and a target date for production readiness.

Thanks — appreciate any flexibility.

— Elena
Elena Torres
Head of ML, Luminary AI
Elena: +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Luminary_usage_snapshot.csv (csv)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@luminary.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-25T16:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial ended early — request to restore credits

Elena — thanks for the quick note and the usage export.

Short answer: we can usually offer a one-time bridge allocation for customers in evaluation if there's a clear plan and an account owner commitment. Two quick asks so I can move this fast:

1) Can you confirm the target tests you need to complete and an estimated token count (ballpark is fine) so we can size the top-up?
2) Are you planning to convert to paid tier after the evaluation window? if so, when would you expect to sign?

If you prefer we can do a 15-min sync tomorrow to go through the list. I can loop in Aditya for approvals if Monica scopes the amount. I attached a proposed mutual action plan template to speed things up.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
D: +1 (206) 555-0143

Attachment: proposed-map.pdf (template)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Trial ended early — request to restore credits

Forwarding Luminary's ask.

Internal notes: Luminary is a healthy PLG lead — trial showed early traction (fine-grained LLM evals). Elena says they need ~150k tokens to finish a short suite of tests, but their usage spike earlier burned more. Recommend one-time top-up of equivalent $800 credit to let them finish and push toward a purchase decision. I'll capture the MAP (mutual action plan) & confirmation of timeline in the next email.

Aditya — can you approve a one-off credit of $800 and below-the-line discount language (no SLA changes, standard T&Cs)? If approved I'll issue as a bridge credit and create a small milestone in the HubSpot deal so we track conversion.

Monica / Dylan — approve one-time bridge credit.

Decision: grant a $800 one-time credit (non-recurring) to Luminary AI on their existing trial account. Conditions:
- Credit expires 30 days after grant date.
- Luminary must confirm the minimal set of tests and a go/no-go date within five business days.
- This is contingent on HubSpot deal DL-78921 being updated with a conversion target (owner: Dylan).

Dylan: please issue the credit, update the HubSpot record with the MAP, and schedule a 15-min follow-up with Elena to confirm the timeline. Monica: I'll waive the need for formal procurement docs for this top-up but please confirm that there are no compliance blockers.

Aditya Rao
Sales Director — Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
